task: Implement Windows bundled Node.js shim (codemie.cmd), update inject_bundled_bin_path probe for .cmd, change shell_cmd to cmd.exe /c, register shim dir via persist(), remove install_node Windows branch from installer.rs and lib.rs, and update runner tests.

key_reasoning.reason: shell_cmd is the core shared dispatch function used by all five Windows runner paths (capture, run_capture, run_stream, run_fresh_env, run_self_update); changing the Windows branch propagates across the entire runner subsystem. Beyond that, four further touchpoints span three distinct layers: pathman.rs probe update (Service), installer.rs + lib.rs deletion (Service), tauri.conf.json bundle.resources addition (Infrastructure), and handlers.js step removal (UI/JS).

bundle.resources is greenfield with no prior pattern in the repo — node runtime layout and NSIS target paths must be determined from scratch. Three-piece alignment risk: inject_bundled_bin_path probe (must detect codemie.cmd), shell_cmd (cmd.exe /c must find .cmd via PATH), and shim (%~dp0.. must resolve to the directory containing node.exe) must all agree; mismatch in any coordinate produces a silent failure. Product name discrepancy ('CodeMie Desktop' in the ticket vs 'CodeMie Connect' in tauri.conf.json:productName) must be resolved before any hardcoded path is committed. Runner Windows tests break with the shell_cmd change and must be replaced with cmd.exe equivalents.

Seven files require substantive edits (runner.rs, pathman.rs, installer.rs, lib.rs, steps.yaml, handlers.js, tauri.conf.json) plus one new file (codemie.cmd), spanning six distinct directories: src-tauri/src/commands/, src-tauri/src/, src-tauri/, config/, ui/, assets/bin/.
